judgments.rewrite_hint: “Through Muse, trained human contract workers made some calls and completed the exchanges with users.” の「with users」を、Ledgerの MUSE-HC-006 に合わせて「with businesses or stores」など、電話の相手が企業・店舗である表現に修正してください。

“These workers did more than make the conversation smooth: the user’s sensitive information might be shared with contract workers at a call center. One helper meant one more person handling private data.” の後半は、情報が実際に扱われたと断定せず、MUSE-HC-010 にある可能性・懸念としての表現にしてください（例：「That raised the possibility that one more person might handle private data」）。
